Game Overview

In Teeth Runner, the core idea is straightforward: battle sugar monsters and cavity creatures as a heroic toothpaste blob in Teeth Runner. Swipe to dodge enemies, collect power-ups, and ensure each tooth is sparkling clean. This fun-filled adventure blends education with vibrant graphics, encouraging healthy dental habits for players of all ages.

Teeth Runner keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Battle sugar monsters and cavity creatures as a heroic toothpaste blob in Teeth Runner.
